avis.texte: I adore these products. They are great for every type of skin & the cleanliness & glowing skin is amazing.
I use this cleanser every night with a silicone brush and it is so relaxing and reviving! It keeps my skin clear and brightens my complexion. I highly reccomend this product!

I absolutely love this product. I look forward to using it every night. Absolutely love the smell, it is so relaxing! It is one product ive found that uses papaya extract, which is a good lightening ingredient. Please never stop making/selling this product!

I was excited to finally try a Mario Badescu product. However, I was very disappointed with this product. It was very ineffective for removing makeup. After the first wash, I looked like a racoon around my eyes. Instead of removing and washing away, the face gel basically smeared the makeup. The fragrance is pretty strong than most facial washes. You don't need a lot to use, which means it's taking me longer to get through this bottle. I will not purchase/recommend this product.
After many years of not trying this cleanser, I finally purchased it. It's pleasant to use and my face feels clean afterwards, albeit a little dry. Still and all I'm happy with the purchase.

I love this cleanser. I think some people commented they don't like the smell and I love it, so that was a nice surprise. I apply to wet skin and try to leave it on for at least two minutes and if I want extra exfoliation, I will add some scrub when I am removing. I have pretty tough skin and can use this every day. And because it is a thick gel, I'm not worried about it leaking when traveling, an added bonus.

This has been my #1 cleanser since high school for good reason. It's smooth, it cleanses well without feeling dry, and it mever fails to calm breakouts I might get. There's a few natural AHAs in there and i think that's what makes it so good at clearing my skin. Only thing of note is that it cannot be used on eyes or to remove makeup, but its no problem grabbing my micellar water before i start using this!

avis.titre: Feels very silky on the skin
avis.texte: I've been using this for a week now, and while I wasn't sure about it the first couple times I washed my face, I feel like it's gotten better with use. It feels very lovely going on, and after a couple days my skin has started to feel softer and the scaly upper midwest winter skin that's been troubling me has gone. The aesthetician who helped me pick this out advised me to let it sit for two minutes on my skin in the evenings to let the enzymes work as she thought my skin was too sensitive for any kind of exfoliating product, I think that's really done the trick. I don't mind the scent, but other people may be put off by it.

I have been using this cleanser for years ( believe it or not Martha Stewart recommended it way back). It is very gentle and at my age need that but it doesnt remove make up well enough for me ( though i wear much lighter make up now - quite frankly my skin looks better the older i get). This is the cleanser i use in the morning to freshen my skin and remove any extra nighttime oil/ treatments. I use Gentle Foaming cleanser in the evening for make up removal and Glycolic Acid Toner both morning and night. Mario Badescu products will not fail you , are at a reasonable price point and very effective once you find what works for you. I am very happy with their fairly new Clarifying serum IF i feel i'm starting to get a blemish ( which ive managed my entire life). It's magic and gentle!

I have senstive, combination skin that is acne-prone. I use a couple other Mario Badescu products and was just using Dr. Bronners tea tree or peppermint for my face and body before. Within a few weeks, my skin was the oiliest it's been in years and was constantly breaking out again. As soon as I stopped and went back to Dr. Bronners, my skin went back to normal and calmed back down.
After using this product i broke out bad ! Its terrible for dry acne prone skin. I have a rash and pimple on my jaw and check because of this product!
Love this cleanser. Its smooth, leaves skin hydrating and glowy. Definitely recommend.
I wanted to love this cleanser but I don't. Nice scent, lathers well but just doesn't cut through my makeup. I have to wash my face 2-3 times to get everything off and I don't wear that much!
I love this face wash, gentle and cleans my face. The scent took about a day to get use to, but now I like this scent and am not use to another scent.

On the search for a good papaya-enzyme cleanser (more natural than 'Likas Papaya' soap which works well but isn't all that great for the skin's PH) and stumbled upon this. The concentration of Papaya in here isn't anywhere near as strong as Likas' soap but it does contain a natural AHA (Grapefruit extract) which would (hopefully) make up for it! Or would it? It works fairly well as a cleanser, although not as good at removing makeup as it's touted to be, had to double-cleanse on all days when trying to remove anything more than oil-free foundation. The fragrance is very strong which isn't a good thing in my books, and as the instructions state: leaving on for 1-2 minutes if you can, is worth doing, as the difference when doing so, compared to when I didn't, could be noticed immediately (smoother, brighter, more refined skin). All in all a fairly good cleanser, not as effective when it comes to brightening as Likas Papaya (despite the addition of that Graperfuit) but an acceptable alternative, considering it's not a bar of skin-stripping soap! -> My 'Ulta Beauty Top 7 must-have list' (My 7 favorite beauty products of all time, focusing mainly on my purchases at Ulta) < - < 1. Hair Loss Treatment: Divine Herbal Hair Oil < 2. Eye Cream: Clinique All about eyes < 3. Lip Gloss: Clarins Lip Comfort Oil < 4. Makeup Remover: Lancome Bi Facil < 5. Pigmentation + Anti-Aging Serum: Divine Herbal Facial Treatment Serum < 6. Eyeliner: Ulta Beauty Gel Eyeliner Pencil < 7. Moisturizer: 'Lus

As said in headline , 8 yrs with this product . If you see this Mario never change the formula ! Ill never forgive if you do !!! I used to use bliss before they changed the formula and thats what prompted for a change of product . This enzyme cleanser has been good to me ! I never break out unless aunt flow comes or i wear make up. I always notice a difference when i wash my face after a long day of work . I pray they never change the formula !

My favorite facial cleanser. It doesn't lather, so you only need a little bit. It works well with me because I have hyperpigmentation. It dries up the scar and falls off like dry skin. This is my 4th bottle.

I don't use this to remove makeup, as there are better options. However, it IS perfect for washing your face in the shower. I have rotated thru various samples for use during my showers as I'm not attempting to remove heavy eye makeup or anything like that. This is the first sample that made a noticeable difference in my skin clarity and brightness, and I only use it during my normal showers. So I bought a full size bottle. It's doesn't smell the greatest, and it doesn't lather. But I'm fine with that if it keeps my skin looking bright and clear.
i've been buying this over and over for about 5 years now. it leaves my skin feeling super soft and never breaks me out. a little goes a very long way

I have normal to dry skin and have been using this gel for about 5 years now. It works so well for my skin and even though sometimes I take a break from it to experiment with other brands I always come back to it. It always leaves my face feeling so clean and fresh. I absolutely recommend it.

I use this after using an oil cleanser when I have makeup on. Like the description says, this will only help with light makeup, which I have found to be true with light primer/powder use. So obviously, if you have more makeup, you'll need a product that's actually intended to remove heavier makeup/the type of makeup you use (funny to read that people are upset that it's not working for makeup removal. It's like if you were mad at a non-oil based makeup remover for not removing all your waterproof makeup). But as a daily gentle cleanser on a bare face, this works wonders for skin texture and tone. It transformed my skin so now instead of marking myself as an oily/combo, I have literally normal skin. I've had my skin evaluated in some sort of beauty consultation and the lady was shocked at my skin quality that she had nothing else to say LOL and I just excused myself because I knew my face looked fine and I didn't need any help. I've tried many other cleansers but I always come back to this. Don't be afraid that it doesn't sud up. Soap suds require a certain chemical reaction and is entirely not necessary in order to cleanse effectively. Anyway, I'm not trying to convince you to use this product, your miles may vary of course, but at least read the descriptions of the products you buy so you know what is going on your skin and what to expect.
I love this creamy face wash especially in the winter in the New York air. Second time buying it because my skin feels so hydrated after use.

I purchased this in a travel set. I really like this cleanser. My skin glows after using it. I don't use it for removing makeup. I use it on bare skin. I have not been wearing makeup during coronavirus, so I didn't use it for that. I will repurchase and recommend to a friend.

I don't write reviews. Ever. But I have been using this enzyme cleansing gel for the last several days and it has made my skin cleaner than ever, without the dryness or breakouts that I typically get from other cleansers. I use it with an exfoliating cloth and my skin feels clean and refreshed each time I use it.

My barely have a breakout skin has erupted into multiple pimples!! My skin is usually even and looks good, but not with this! I've never broke out so much with a face wash before. I got this as a sample and used it for about 2 weeks. I can't believe in that short amount of time it could do so much damage. Also, the smell isn't great.

avis.titre: I will never buy these products
avis.texte: After one use, it Made my face so dry it looked like straight up sand paper!!! Ew. If you have sensitive skin, do not buy this product!!!!

my sister gave me a gift box of mario badescu products for Christmas that included this item. I was excited to try it out but it's not for me. it smells like soap you might find in a public bathroom, which I really dislike. it doesn't lather and it doesn't leave my face feeling clean. I'm really disappointed in it.
This is a good company and their products are good. My hands were to weak to use this bottle.

avis.titre: idk what it is about this stuff
avis.texte: but I love it. it doesn't lather. it doesn't foam. it doesn't tingle. but it leaves my skin feeling cleaner, brighter, and plumper. and it lasts FOREVER. I've had the same bottle for over a year and I just now bought a new one bc it's expired after a year. amazing stuff. very homeopathic aromatherapy scented.

very refreshing cleanser if used as the second step of a double cleanse routine or on a no makeup day. did cause me to breakout a bit but that may be because I wasn't getting a deep enough cleanse on my first wash.

avis.titre: 5 stars for the way I use it
avis.texte: So I do not use this cleanser to remove make up, it doesn't do very well at that. If you do you have to wash two times at least. Are use it in the morning in the shower after having remove my make up and applied skin care the night before. It is not strip my skin barrier but it does effectively cleanse and resurface my skin by encouraging cell turnover. I would give it a one out of five stars for make up removal and a five out of five for second cleanse or morning cleanse no make up on.

I loved the smell. I've tried other products by this brand and saw the great reviews so I decided to try it. This does not cleanse my skin. I use a cotton pad to apply toner after each use of cleansing gel. Cotton pad is ALWAYS filthy and I have to wash my face again using another product.

No matter how much I want to like it, Mario Badescu products (especially this face wash) just break me out. I have oily, sensitive, acne prone skin. looking at the ingredients, it's probably all of the perfumes and mica that don't agree with my skin. Don't get me wrong, my face FEELS clean after use, but acne galore is the result. I also find it quote drying. it does not help with makeup removal either. Sadly, I'm ditching my MB collection for safer skincare for me.

avis.titre: Only thing that doesn't break me out
avis.texte: I've tried a million face washes. Its so wierd that every like derm person i see says mario bedescu products dont work bla bla but ive tried dermalogica cus i love jackie aina & shes always pushing it - broke me out, ive used clinique face washes, feels like im washing w bar soap. I love this cleanser its way better then those two high end cleansers
I often house/pet sit so keep the whole like of products there. They are great, they last a long time and Is gentle on my skin. We will continue to purchase these products !
As an older person with rosacea, I usually don't try anything new. Heard good things about this brand. Cooling with gentle cleaning and didn't irritate my skin.
Didn't do much for my skin and feel like it cleaned just okay.

This took a couple uses to appreciate. It's like applying a lotion to your face. While it doesn't foam up or lather, it leaves my skin feeling cleansed and soft. While the scent isn't ideal compared to other products from this maker (it smells like grandma), I like it so much that I overlook the smell.

does very little to actually cleanse skin. I was wondering why I kept getting pimples...when I washed this morning and toned my toning pad showed dirt....like my skin was never cleaned to begun with...I've been using it for a week and my skin has been crazy with breakout. no wonder. it's not actually being cleaned

Make sure you are doing the double wash on your face with this stuff. Only works for me when I use a scrub first. Doesn't lather well either. Feel like it slides off my face more than cleanses. With all that being said it may work for someone with delicate skin.

avis.titre: Doesn't get all the grime off
avis.texte: The product smells nice and has good consistency, but I find that it just doesn't clean my face very well in comparison to my other cleansers. I know this because there is always a lot more makeup left on my toner pad after I use this face wash, so it is not getting all my makeup off.

avis.titre: Only Cleanser that Works for Me
avis.texte: First time I used this I wasn't expecting an immediate change in my skin... but I woke up the next morning and my skin was clear, refreshed, and camera-ready. I use the cucumber toner and vitamin c moisturizer with this every single day and all I want to do is take pictures of my skin because it looks (and feels) so healthy.
This face wash is amazing!! I love the way that my face feel soft and smooth after I wash- You won't be disappointed

avis.titre: I will be using this product from now on
avis.texte: I love this facial cleanser. I normally have some burning, dryness and sensitivity to facial cleansers but this doesn't both me to use twice a day, everyday!

avis.titre: I will be a customer for life with this product.
avis.texte: My partner and I both have been using this product for over a year and will continue using. He has very oily skin whereas I have combination and this product works well for us both. I notice that if I don't use it for a few days my skin will start getting oily and I will have very minor break outs (my skin has never been very acne prone).
Perfect for dry skin. Very little product goes a long way. The bottle looks bigger in person so it's worth the price.
I don't use it everyday but when I do my face fees so refreshed and clean.

avis.titre: Love this product for an everyday use
avis.texte: Love this product for an everyday face wash leaves my skin soft and fresh

My Mom gifted me this cleanser and I decide to use it since my go to product was out of stock...I check all the reviews and decide to give it a chance. At first it reduce a few of the pimples I had and it also seem to help my acne scars however after a few more uses pimples began to appear; of course I debated on not using this product anymore but just as new pimple came; it went away. Finally after a month a half I notice my forehead which never had pimples began to have small cluster of pimples/whiteheads. I finally stop using it and it clear up....I rather stick to my go to product from now on!
This a great refreshing cleanser but not to remove makeup it's very hydrating and great 10/10 would recommend

To start, the smell of this is awful. The packaging is so cheap and annoying. I don't even have sensitive skin and I feel like this made my skin burn. I couldn't even try to finish the bottle I ended up throwing it out.

This did not cleanse at all for me. I wanted to like this product but even after using it in the shower I my skin still felt unclean. I thought that I just had to get used to it but the longer I used it the worse my skin looked. Even my fiancé who doesn't care what he washes his face with felt that it didn't do anything and did not like it.
I use this every day, morning and evening. It leaves my skin feeling dewy and soft. I first used this with a sample kit of a personalized MB regime. I would recommend this to everyone!
This gel felt so nice on my face, however, I felt like it wasn't "cleansing" my face. I try to alternate between using this and the foaming cleanser, but I love the latter so much more.

This I got as a sample it is amazing it is not soapy or foamy it's just like a gel mostly feels amazing smells amazing and leaves your skin so soft I love it also it has improved the texture on my skin will buy full size

I bought this for my husband after an aesthetician recommended an enzyme cleanser for his acne prone skin and this has worked miracles. His skin is noticeably clearer with structured, continuous use and helps balance oil as well. This is a great product.

This is a gentle cleanser that removes light makeup so it's good for everyday use. It has the perfect gel consistency that's not too runny. I like that it is sulfate-free so it doesn't foam up, which is great for my dry skin. It has a short list of ingredients including papaya and grapefruit extracts but also fragrance (subtle) and parabens.

I'm still getting used to this one. It is so gentle that it feels like I'm washing my face with lotion. But when I'm done, my face feels clean so I know it's working. It doesn't lather or anything like that--it just gives me a yummy, plump, clean feeling.
Helps immensely with my breakouts! Just a tad drying when an everyday use.

I was a huge fan of the seaweed cleanser so I decided to give this a try. The smell is clean and fresh but it is quite thick and doesn't spread well on the skin, stays clumped up on my hands when trying to massage it into my face. I don't have that overall great clean feeling after using but it works okay.
This face wash dose not foam up, and Im not sure I love that. Its nice.
I've been using this cleanser for about 2 weeks and I like it so far. It is a good size for a really good price! The only thing that bothers me is that it doesn't lather but it's not a deal breaker.

After trying a small sample bottle of this cleanser I liked it. It does have a perfume smell to it which I don't care for in my cleansers but other then that its ok. I have to use it with the Ordinary Squalance Cleanser because that cleanser leaves an oily residue on the skin that's why I double cleanse . After seeing the ingredients of this product I m going to return it because I read one review that the ingredients are not good for your skin.

avis.titre: good cleanser if you don't have makeup on
avis.texte: I use this cleanser some mornings or before using mask. This cleanser does not remove my makeup, so I use a different cleanser at night. It is gentle, but recommends different cleanser to remove makeup.

avis.titre: Combination - More Sensitive Skin Loves this
avis.texte: Been using this product for two years now and I will never go back. It works well with my RX grade Acne cream. Plus because it's a gel it doesn't make my skin feel super tight like the foaming cleansers do. Plus I really love the cucumber scent, it's refreshing. I must warn that it is a GENTLE cleanser. It's not good at removing deep make up gunk dirt. You either need to get better make up removers ( not the wipe, if you still use wipes and blame this product, they clearly haven't done their research of any sort), double cleanse, or I use the make up eraser cloth, sometimes I exfoliate instead because I usually don't wear make up.

I use this product in my double cleansing skin regimen. I have both dry AND sensitive skin and this cleanser is great for both. I use a different brands cleanser afterwards but this one is great for a minimal hydrating cleanse and honestly lasts for a super long time.

Although this product feels nice to use, the ingredients are so harmful! Not only does it have parabens and perfumes, which can cause a lot of irritation--it also contains Phenoxyethanol, which is harmful to your brain and nervous system when absorbed into the skin. Please please please do not use this product if you care about your skin! There are plenty of clean, safe skincare alternatives out there!

avis.titre: Smells amazing and skin feels so smooth
avis.texte: I use this twice a day it feels so calming And refreshing on my skin. Skin feels clean and smooth. Price is fair too—much less than fancy ones

I've used this cleanser about two years now. It's the only cleanser that prevents breakouts for me! It's super gentle and doesn't lather. I just massage it on to my face! I had a small gap that I didn't use it (used Murad) and my forehead broke out in small bumps, it was so embarrassing! After going back to using this about a week or so, the acne is about 80% clear! I swear by this product, though I have recommended it to friends who weren't fans of it. My own skin type is combination, more on the oily side. This even controls that, in my opinion with consistent use.

I have extremely dry skin and this cleanser does not irritate it at all! This is the only cleanser that I have found that does not burn my skin or feel like it's being rubbed raw! Will be buying again!

avis.titre: Have Tried Others - Love This One!
avis.texte: My 40+ year face deals with dryness, acne, and wrinkles. I use this several times a week and have noticed an incredible difference in reduced acne and skin softness. This is definitely one of my favorite Mario Badescu products!!

I only use this in the morning not at night to take make-up off. I don't think it's really good for that. I'm older now and my skin used to be really oily. Sometimes it is now and sometimes it isn't. It fluctuates. That being said, this cleanser seems to help keep me a little more balanced because the foaming, cleansing ones that remove the makeup at night can be more harsh and drying. Using this in the morning makes my skin feel more soft and nourished, less parched, and I get less flaky.

avis.titre: Great for to add to cleansing routine
avis.texte: I use this regularly , but don't Use it to take off makeup . I use in the shower after I've exfoliated and cleansed (reverse order ).

I heard good things about this cleanser and I was excited to try it out. I've struggled with acne for a few years now and I've only found one cleanser that I love, but it's been sold out everywhere. I thought this one would clear my skin up after hearing people talk about how much they love it. At first I was really liking it and how it made my skin feel, but after a few washes my skin looked HORRIBLE. I can't say my acne was 100% caused by this cleanser because I do have to wear a mask at work everyday and I'm sure that it's great for my skin, but this product was definitely causing acne on my forehead and upper cheek areas where my mask doesn't cover (these are areas where I rarely ever get acne). I've been using the La Roche Posay one and my skin is already starting to clear up!

I really wanted to like this product because the price was great and I hear great things about Mario Badescu. I have to say that this product could very well be fantastic, but the smell was so unbearable, that I could not use it twice. It smells like your grandmothers perfume that went bad from sitting in the window in the sun but she insists on wearing it even though it makes everyone sneeze. Just absolutely RANCID !!!
It does it's job however if you're looking for that "clean feeling" this will not do that for you. It's a very mild/gentle cleaner that doesn't lather.
this made my skin 10 times worse than it was before i started using this. it's full of fragrance and is just terrible for you.
I have oily sensitive skin, this cleanser doesn't irritate my skin but also doesn't feel like it gets all the oil and dirt off.

avis.titre: Beware: Pore-clogging ingredients in this product
avis.texte: This cleanser contains PEG-8 Stearate (used as a surfactant and emulsifier) and this will break you out and clog pores if you are a person that identifies with blemish-prone skin. I was, however, able to repurpose this a brush and sponge cleanser and LET ME TELL YOU it melted the makeup RIGHT OFF my BeautyBlender and makeup brushes. After I finished the bottle, I did not purchase another one out of fear of running the risk that using this product to cleanse my sponges and brushes could still lead to breakouts. Just wanted to spread the word on my experience with this product. Hope it works for you, but didn't for me—not as a skin cleanser at least:)

I wanted to love this product so much. After three days I started to breakout on my chin, my forehead and I had never had breakouts in those areas. Apparently so they say, some of their line carries steroids which causes breakouts. I know people who love it but I unfortunately do not. I have sensitive skin and don't usually breakout.

i got this free from ulta from another purchase but it was still a 29 ml bottle. made me break out in places ive never broke out before and when i stopped using it i stopped breaking out. this is one of the only products to ever do this to my face i don't have sensitive skin or anything.
Great face was to use, replace 2-3x a week with your normal face wash
After trying a sample size, I really loved the clean and refreshing effect of the cleansing gel and ordered a larger size.
I hated this stuff. It has a cloying, overpowering scent and it made my eyes burn. Enough said; couldn't stand to finish it. Into the trash it went.

First off...it smells like a old lady with lots of perfume. The smell is so offputting. Second...this stuff does NOT remove makeup at all. I had to wash my face a few times and when I was done decided to run a cotton swab w toner and the makeup was still coming off. This will be my last purchase from this brand. I have still been using it but
Always have this in my routine. It's gentle enough to use in the mornings for my combination skin. I use it year round.
This cleanser removes my makeup and anything else on my skin really well! It also leaves my skin looking bright and it doesn't dry out my skin.

I started using this when I was pregnant, at first I thought it wasn't do anything, since my skin was glowing. but noo, after a year of giving birth it helped clear any overnight acne and minimized pores. made my skin feel soft and fresh! my baby will be 2 in 2 months, I've been using this for a while, buying more !

I have been using this for about a year now in the mornings and whenever I need a quick wash during the day. I really like it! It smells very nice but isn't overpowering, and does a nice job cleansing the face. It is not a lathering cleanser, but it definitely does the job. It leaves my skin feeling soft, clean, and fresh. I purchased the larger size about a year ago and still have almost 1/3 left; the nice thing is you don't need a lot! I just repurchased again and would definitely recommend. Is it anything crazy amazing? No. But it is a very nice basic facial cleanser. It also didn't irritate my very sensitive skin at all which is always a plus.

avis.titre: I liked it, but then it gave me a skin reaction
avis.texte: I honestly really wanted to like this product, but after a few uses my skin completely broke out in hives. I know this company has a history of being a bit dishonest in their ingredients list, so be aware. I usually don't have sensitive skin like this, so I'm a bit shocked. My eye has been itching and swollen for the past 3 days, I just threw this in the garbage. I know people who use this product and love it, this was just my personal experience!
does not sud up my face. doesn't even feel like it does anything when applying or washing off.
It cleansed my face well and didn't irritate my skin but I wouldn't repurchase because the ingredients list is less than ideal.
This soap smells so good and it leaves my skin feeling clean! Great price point too.
I rarely if ever use this but my other half swears by it. He uses it mainly in the summer as oils increase.
This is my first time using this cleanser and I'm loving it! It makes my skin feel refreshed and not dried out like other cleansers I've used in the past.

This formula contains fragrance and some harsh chemicals, which can make your skin worse or cause new problems. I am allergic to dyes and perfumes, so this really irritates my skin. If you have sensitive skin, stay away from this product and brand.

I had a lot of redness and scaring from acne before and this has helped so much. I use all of these products. The cleanser gel, the scrub, toner, whitening mask and night scream and my face has made a huge improvement! I have no problem at all going anywhere without makeup now. I love this brand
I feel like it doesn't really do anything for my skin/breakouts (I have normal to dry skin) but my skin does feel very clean after I use it. I don't love it or hate it. Just a good cleanser.

avis.titre: Don't believe the hype! It's destroyed my face
avis.texte: I spent 100$ on the whole line for my skin type. I only used the wash and lotion. My fave turned red and dry. It hurt for a week.
i had pretty bad acne until i got a sample of this, i started using it twice a day and within a week my face cleared. i have not stopped using it since then and when i do i notice a difference.

I love Mario Badescu products. This gel is gentle and makes my skin feel clean. I follow it up with the toner, moisturizer and serum. it has worked for me. I can tell a difference in the way I feel and how my skin looks after using my skincare products. My skin hates me if I miss a day or two without it. This cleanser is good for my skin. I would say I have normal/combo skin for reference. Anyway, there is nothing wrong with this cleanser. I also really like the bottle and how easy it is to get the product out. Great packaging.

Disclaimer: this cleanser is not going to have suds or remove make up. It is not a cleansing balm. It does remove the remaining layers of make up once you've removed the initial layer using a facial wipe. It melts into the skin which I like for my dry and sensitivity and brightens once I rinse my face off. The travel last me a long time by using 4 drops per wash and I only use my hands to wash my face and seen amazing results in the last 6 months of using this cleanser.

avis.titre: Very drying. Stay away if you have sensitive skin
avis.texte: I have sensitive skin. I normally wash my face 2x per day but with quarantine and being lazy, it's gone to 1x per day. Yeah, gross! I bought this because I like their facial spray. The description states " Perfect for all skin types, the cleanser features fruit enzymes and alpha hydroxy acids (found naturally in papya and grapefruit extracts) to gently exfoliate the buidlup of dead skin cells that can block pores and cause blemishes. Skin is left healthy and rejuvenated." I was hesitant to buy it but it was a really good price at Ulta so I said the facial spray is good and keeps me refreshed so why not? Why not.... that was my last thought. My face is ashy and I'm breaking out. I was going to stick it out but used it for a week. Your face doesn't feel tight after you wash. It takes a while before it hits you. My skin feels taut and it took until the end of the day before I felt it. I know I have to stop it because not only am I getting ashy skin and acne, one pimple is growing under the skin and it hurts. It's one of those! The scent is OK. It's not amazing but it doesn't smell horrible. I don't really like scented items since I have sensitive skin. The color is a pretty green. The consisency is thicker than normal but it is gel. It doesn't foam up and takes a little longer to wash away. I really wanted to like this product but if you have sensitive skin, stay away. It's going to take me a while for my skin to go back to normal!

A few months ago I went shopping for a new facial cleanser and this one checks all my boxes! I'm 30, with sensitive, combo skin (more on the oily side). This cleanser is exactly what I was hoping for. My skin doesn't look red or irritated, it feels smooth and balanced, and I no longer break out (my break outs were a bump here or there). One thing other reviewers seem to have an issue with is removing makeup. I don't find this to be an issue. I typically use my Foreo Luna a night and I don't need to cleanse twice.
This is the ONLY product I've found that can clear my sensitive, acne prone skin

I actually use almost all Mario B products; eye cream, serum, moisturizers, so I thought I'd try the cleanser. Super disappointed. It does not remove makeup. It did not sud up on my face, and in fact felt like it disappeared as soon as I ran it over my face. I actually had to wash my face after using to get my makeup off and clean my skin thoroughly. The cherry on top is the scent reminds me of my passed grandmother - and I'm 40!
I use this in the shower or after I use makeup and it works pretty well. It's nothing extraordinary but for the price it's good. I would recommend buying it if you want a cleanser.

I keep going back to this face wash. I learned the more foamy a wash was, the more it stripped my skin even when I follow up with moisturizer, etc. This wash has saved me of my insecurities of dark spots from acne, which I struggled with all through high school. I believe I owe that to the papaya enzymes working their magic. It continues to be a staple in my skin care regimen, and I have out friends and my sister on it as well. The gel is a nice change because it makes my skin feel clean without feeling stripped! I really enjoy this wash. Buy the trial size if anything to give it a test.

I have very sensitive skin so I tried using this along with the cucumber cleansing lotion and my face started clearing up so quick! ❤️ the gel is very soft and relaxing on your face and not to mention it smells so good. Very refreshing.
I bought this during the skin event and it broke me out instantly. Smells like old lady and doesnt foam or even lather. If you have oily skin like me it leaves a weird film on your face.

avis.titre: I don't like anything about this
avis.texte: I bought this because of the reviews and the products claims. right off the bat upon using it it stinks and doesn't get my skin clean also leaves a film. I'm almost half way through the bottle and hate it but don't want to throw it away and waste more money- also super annoyed it doesn't have a pump because I'm wetting my face then the bottle gets wet. my skin is oily I've noticed clogged pores and texture.
I have combination skin and it helped with my dry and oily spots. It great for sensitive skin.

I received a free bottle of this when I bought my Mia Clarisonic. Once I ran out of my regular cleanser, I gave this a try. Worst mistake ever! My normally clear skin broke out in terrible acne complete with white heads like never in my life. Plus, the smell is overpowering with perfume and the gel does not lather or do much of anything. I stopped after 2 uses and tossed-I hope it doesn't take long for my skin to return to normal. Please save yourself the trouble-there are tons of other great quality (and price comparable) cleansers on the market.
Really wanted to love this but made me break out terribly everytime I used it and I usually have pretty clear skin
I bought this for my teenage son and his acne and we saw improvement the first week. Along with the toner this is a great product that actually works.

I didn't care for this brand until there was a sale & I got it on a discount. Best thing I've done since it pushed my skin to the next level. Less scarring, less acne, and my skin feels healthier! It doesn't lather so I end up using more than I need to (that's something I need to fix), but overall....this really helped with my skin! I bought another one already.
The scent is overwhelming and unnecessarily strong. This cleansing gel did nothing to clean my face had to follow up with a second cleanser and toner to get rid of small traces of makeup.

Troubled combination skin....I've used this cleanser for three years, it has never exacerbated breakouts, leaves my skin clean, soft, and balanced. This will NOT lather, but that's never turned me off to it.
